notes: [S007.N1] This typescript has two prose paragraphs and one displayed distributivity formula, with unnamed pen additions and corrections. It carries archive numeral 6, no legible upper author page number, no date, no title and no stated total. The initial ent is retained as the page’s fragment; cancelled Picar is not completed. The insertion connectors beside suivante. and ordinaire are ordinary attachment strokes, represented by inserted at their attachments.

[S007.N2] The opening proposes relations between n- and infinity-categories, simplicial or topological objects, and strict Picard categories and truncated chain complexes. Its phrases relations qu’on pressent, Il y aurait à s’attendre and pourrait bien remain tentative. In the next paragraph Il y aurait lieu d’étudier introduces categories with two operations and compatible distributivity, followed by a proposed structure theory. It states a ring on pi_0 and a module on pi_1, then asks Quels autres invariants faut-il introduire. The pi_1 module assertion and that classification programme are not proved here.

[S007.N3] Limited check of the pi_0 conclusion: on isomorphism classes the assumed Picard sum gives an abelian group. The stated coherent tensor structure gives associative, commutative, unital multiplication. The displayed isomorphism gives x(y+z)=xy+xz, and commutativity gives the other distributive law. Additive cancellation in x0=x(0+0)=x0+x0 gives x0=0. Thus the commutative-ring conclusion follows conditional on those structures. This is not a construction of the second operation, a proof of the pi_1 action, or a classification theorem; the transcription is unchanged.

[S007.N4] Crop decisions resolve old de beneath plus, the transposed old or beneath ro after the clean p of projectifs, old str beneath loi, old a in provenant de, the handwritten s after de, old e beneath the corrected évidents ending, and the cancelled extra a in opérations. The second infinity-like form remains literally 6o-like first. ACU and AUC retain their differing source orders; chaines and acute homótopique are not modernised.
